WITH anon_1 AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_2.fact_id AS fact_id, CASE WHEN (anon_2.open_qty > anon_2.shipped_qty) THEN anon_2.open_qty - anon_2.shipped_qty ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END AS counted_qty 
FROM (SELECT fact_inbound_shipment_1.id AS fact_id, lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) AS state, coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_3)s::INTEGER) AS open_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER) ELSE %(param_2)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS shipped_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::INTEGER ELSE %(param_4)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS n_shipped 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment AS fact_inbound_shipment_1 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no) != '' AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code) != '' AND lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) IN (%(lower_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(lower_2_2)s::VARCHAR) AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR) AS anon_2 
WHERE anon_2.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND anon_2.n_shipped > %(n_shipped_1)s::INTEGER)
 SELECT fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id, coalesce(sum(coalesce(anon_1.counted_qty, fact_inbound_shipment.quantity)), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment LEFT OUTER JOIN anon_1 ON anon_1.fact_id = fact_inbound_shipment.id
